modules.ipa-plus.text.e29e145a3a1e: Click a symbol to replace the selection or insert at the last cursor position. Light buttons insert a complete example. Dotted circles only show where diacritics attach. Switching charts and searching retain the text and undo history.
modules.ipa-plus.text.730f371bdc16: Diacritics are arranged in columns according to window width, with names and symbols shown together. Hover over names for brief explanations or symbols for full details. IPA and extIPA show all sections by default; individual sections can also be selected. The charts scroll while the editor stays visible. The top size control adjusts symbols in all three charts and the editor from 18 to 54; name and explanation sizes stay unchanged.
modules.ipa-plus.text.f15d5bc7f5cd: Scope tools enclose selected content. Tie bars and glide arrows connect two selected graphemes. Ctrl/⌘+Z undoes; Ctrl/⌘+Shift+Z redoes. Finish Chinese IME composition before inserting.
modules.ipa-plus.text.f50455d33d7c: Right-click a symbol or press Alt+Enter to open its details. Disabling hover descriptions stops automatic popups; brief name tooltips remain available. Details appear near the symbol away from the pointer and allow reading and scrolling when entered.
modules.ipa-plus.text.ac3b6cca7894: Click-to-play is not yet available. Demonstrations are being created for a later update; clicking currently inserts symbols.
modules.ipa-plus.text.c468f01851c1: Drafts save automatically on this device. A cross-window conflict stops writing and retains both current text and the original record. Save text requests a UTF-8 download; confirm the file. Copying transfers characters only; other software needs an appropriate font.
modules.ipa-plus.text.f6a4989f3e63: PTB IPA Plus 1.000 retains Doulos SIL 7.000 glyphs and adds combining brackets and circled-positioning support, distributed under OFL 1.1. Multicharacter circled forms use explicit ⟅…⟆ text substitutes; see each entry's description for differences.
modules.ipa-plus.text.ce2f539f3077: After web resources load, editing works without a connection. Reopening offline after the browser closes has no PWA cache guarantee. Input is not sent to the server; source links are visited only when opened explicitly.
